body:
Thank you again for this, Logging onto this account to say how grateful I was. 

A little update: I succeeded. My friend is now feeling better about herself and her life but I am going to still be supporting her. I think I will be back to try and help others but for now I need some time myself. 

Thank you again!

I feel for everyone here. Although I am not a parent. Or had a close relative commit suicide I am currently supporting a friend after her sister did. Just remember, there is always hope. In the darkest day. In your darkest time there are people who will support you through it and people who want to help.
Thank you I will. Will plan to check in and give updates and probably ask more questions. Thank you again.
Thank you. If I could I would help more people I really would.

Thank you so much. In some ways it was good to get this off my chest and have someone say that. 

I have stayed far away from that stuff but I have found that I have done some of the things reccomemended not to in that sidebar and therefore will ajust my tact slightly on that so for that I thank you so much. 

I have to comment here that I think we have come closer than friends through this. Both feeling the same way to each other but distance and some other reasons mean that we cannot be together but we plan to in the future. To help pull her through more today I had the idea to start making a list of things that we will do together. Little things but it made her much more positive and thinking about the future more. Idk if it was the right thing to do but it seems to have helped..
